title: Amino Acid Analysis Service
author: Sherry Cryer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uu8ewzw

steps.title: Acid Hydrolysis of Sample
steps.instruction: Hydrolyze the protein sample in 6 M hydrochloric acid for 24 hours at 110 °C.

steps.title: Consider Amino‑Acid Stability
steps.instruction: Be aware that fragile amino acids, especially tryptophan and cysteine, may be partially destroyed during the acid hydrolysis.

steps.title: Derivatize Amino Acids
steps.instruction: Derivatize the hydrolyzed amino acids either pre‑column or post‑column with the appropriate reagent for sensitive detection.

steps.title: Chromatographic Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the derivatized amino acids using a reversed‑phase / strong‑cation‑exchange (RP/SCX) column.

steps.title: Quantify with Standards
steps.instruction: Quantify each amino acid using internal and external standards of known amount to achieve accurate quantification.
